## Names

<a id="place_bruce_at_room_start"></a>
### [`place_bruce_at_room_start`](../../../src/room_misc_support.asm#L11) `$3217`

*routine*

Puts Bruce at the start position of room X and enters that room. Input: X = room number (0-19). Sets current_actor = 0 (Bruce), next_room = X, and loads the start position from spawn_a_x/spawn_a_y,X. Then it jumps to enter_room, which stores the position, sets room, draws the room, resets the stack and enters the main loop. It does not return. Callers: lose_fall (respawn in the same room), draw_room (the room 11 shortcut to room 13) and room19_frame (back to room 0 for the next game loop).

- **Called from:** [`draw_room`](draw_room.md#draw_room) [`$0A0B`](../../../src/draw_room.asm#L67), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall) [`$188B`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L75), [`room19_frame`](ending_room.md#room19_frame) [`$4295`](../../../src/ending_room.asm#L48)
- **Jumps to:** [`enter_room`](background_touch.md#enter_room)
- **Writes:** [`current_actor`](../memory-map.md#current_actor), [`next_room`](../memory-map.md#next_room)
- **Refers to:** [`spawn_a_y`](room_tables.md#spawn_a_y), [`spawn_a_x`](room_tables.md#spawn_a_x)

<a id="update_burst_traps"></a>
### [`update_burst_traps`](../../../src/room_misc_support.asm#L33) `$3228`

*routine*

Updates the three burst trap slots (floor traps that erupt after an actor touches them). A slot starts when an actor touches trap char $60 whose colour is not 5 (touch_trap_tile): the slot counter burst_trap_timer+n becomes 1, the cell above-left of the touched cell goes to burst_trap_row+n (row) and burst_trap_col+n (column), and the touched cell gets colour 5 so it does not trigger again. Each call increments every active counter (0 = slot free). By the counter value before the increment: $08: tiles $2F/$30 (chars $F1-$F6, 3 wide x 2 rows) and sound $8D $0C: tiles $31/$32 (chars $F7-$FC) $10: tiles $2F/$30 again (no sound) $14: top row blank (tile 0), bottom row tile $33 (chars $FD $E0 $FD) with colour 8 on its middle cell, so the trap char $60 is armed again $18: counter = 0, slot free. The burst chars $71-$7C kill an actor on contact (handle_touched_tile). Called by the frame handlers of rooms 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16 and 17. Uses burst_slot as the slot index (2..0).

- **Called from:** [`room06_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room06_frame) [`$39BD`](../../../src/room_frames_0_7.asm#L530), [`room07_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room07_frame) [`$39C3`](../../../src/room_frames_0_7.asm#L543), [`room10_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room10_frame) [`$3CBD`](../../../src/room_frames_8_11.asm#L314), [`room11_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room11_frame) [`$3CD6`](../../../src/room_frames_8_11.asm#L330), [`room12_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room12_frame) [`$3E79`](../../../src/room_frames_12_17.asm#L34), [`room14_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room14_frame) [`$3EE3`](../../../src/room_frames_12_17.asm#L100), [`room16_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room16_frame) [`$3F6E`](../../../src/room_frames_12_17.asm#L177), [`room17_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room17_frame) [`$3FD5`](../../../src/room_frames_12_17.asm#L245)

<a id="score_to_bcd"></a>
### [`score_to_bcd`](../../../src/room_misc_support.asm#L142) `$32DC`

*routine*

Converts the score to decimal digits for the status line. Input: score, a 24-bit binary number (high byte first). Output: 8 packed BCD digits in bcd_conv_digits..bcd_conv_digits+3 (high to low). Work copy of the score in bcd_conv_binary..+2. Method: shift the binary number left 24 times; after each shift double the BCD value in decimal mode and add the carry. Keeps the decimal flag state of the caller (PHP/PLP).

- **Called from:** [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over) [`$192D`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L162), [`show_score`](score.md#show_score) [`$315A`](../../../src/score.asm#L40)
- **Reads:** [`score+1`](../memory-map.md#score), [`score+2`](../memory-map.md#score), [`bcd_conv_binary+2`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary), [`bcd_conv_binary+1`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary), [`bcd_conv_binary`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary), [`bcd_conv_digits+2`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits), [`bcd_conv_digits+3`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits)
- **Writes:** [`bcd_conv_binary+1`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary), [`bcd_conv_binary+2`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary), [`bcd_conv_digits+1`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits), [`bcd_conv_digits+2`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits), [`bcd_conv_digits+3`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits), [`bcd_conv_binary`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary)
